title: Cytochrome c, Found in a Test Tube

scenes.tts: Can a cell's death be made to run in a test tube? In 1996, Xiaodong Wang's laboratory made it happen. They took the soluble contents of HeLa cells. They added the nucleotide D A T P. And caspase three switched on.
scenes.caption: Can a cell's death be made to run in a test tube? In 1996, Xiaodong Wang's laboratory made it happen. They took the soluble contents of HeLa cells. They added the nucleotide dATP. And caspase-3 switched on.
scenes.visual: An empty test tube and a dashed caspase-3 chip marked off. The soluble contents of HeLa cells (idealised grey dots) fill the tube, a dATP chip drops in, and the caspase-3 chip turns solid and reads on.
scenes.narration: Can a cell's death be made to run in a test tube? In 1996, Xiaodong Wang's laboratory made it happen. They took the soluble contents of HeLa cells. They added the nucleotide dATP. And caspase-3 switched on.

scenes.tts: Which part of those contents was needed? The laboratory fractionated them. That narrowed the requirement to one small protein. Then came a test. An antibody removed that protein, and the reaction stopped.
scenes.caption: Which part of those contents was needed? The laboratory fractionated them. That narrowed the requirement to one small protein. Then came a test. An antibody removed that protein, and the reaction stopped.
scenes.visual: The grey dots sort into bands (idealised) and all but one dashed question-mark disc dim: one small protein. The dots return, an antibody chip takes the disc out of the tube, and caspase-3 goes back to dashed and off.
scenes.narration: Which part of those contents was needed? The laboratory fractionated them. That narrowed the requirement to one small protein. Then came a test. An antibody removed that protein, and the reaction stopped.

scenes.tts: Then the laboratory added the pure protein back, and the reaction was restored. The protein was cytochrome c. It is the small protein that carries electrons to complex four. Once it leaves the mitochondrion, it has a second job.
scenes.caption: Then the laboratory added the pure protein back, and the reaction was restored. The protein was cytochrome c. It is the small protein that carries electrons to complex IV. Once it leaves the mitochondrion, it has a second job.
scenes.visual: A pure orange disc drops into the tube and caspase-3 turns on again. The disc is named cytochrome c. Two chips beside it read job one, carries electrons to complex IV, and job two, the order to take the cell apart.
scenes.narration: Then the laboratory added the pure protein back, and the reaction was restored. The protein was cytochrome c. It is the small protein that carries electrons to complex IV. Once it leaves the mitochondrion, it has a second job.

scenes.tts: The next year, the laboratory purified its partner, Apaf one, a relative of the worm's C E D four. Cytochrome c and D A T P make seven copies of Apaf one assemble into a wheel, the apoptosome. It gathers caspase nine, as the death-inducing signaling complex gathers caspase eight. Take cytochrome c away, and the reaction stops. Give it back, and it is restored.
scenes.caption: The next year, the laboratory purified its partner, APAF-1, a relative of the worm's CED-4. Cytochrome c and dATP make seven copies of APAF-1 assemble into a wheel, the apoptosome. It gathers caspase-9, as the death-inducing signaling complex gathers caspase-8. Take cytochrome c away, and the reaction stops. Give it back, and it is restored.
scenes.visual: Seven teal APAF-1 blobs appear, with cytochrome c and dATP they close into a wheel, the apoptosome, and dashed caspase-9 chains gather at its hub. Then two rows: cytochrome c taken away, caspase-3 off; given back, caspase-3 on.
